subject: Data description entry
notes: The rule is over the WHOLE clause list and was an || chain of local decode flags that could not see ALIGNED, DYNAMIC LENGTH, GROUP-USAGE, PROPERTY, SELECT WHEN or the validation clauses - so 01 A SAME AS Z ALIGNED. compiled clean. It now reads the WRITTEN clause SET (DataDescriptionCst.WrittenClauses) against SameAsCoPermitted, a constant transcribed from the rule's sentence, and names the offending clause in the message. DataClauseKindDriftTests fails in both directions when a dataDescriptionClause alternative has no DataClauseKind, so the set cannot go incomplete again. kb/Work PB487.
